findings.description: The primary CTA in the hero section (app/page.tsx line ~289) links to /login instead of /register. Change href="/login" to href="/register" in both the primary button ("Try Demo — Instant Access") and the banner link.

findings.issue: Dynamic import via eval() in email utility
findings.description: lib/email.ts line 17 uses eval('import("resend")') to load the Resend package. This breaks in strict Content Security Policy (CSP) environments and is flagged by security scanners. Replace with a standard try/catch around await import('resend').

The tab displays a card with a link to /register, but users clicking 'Get Started' expect to see a registration form, not another navigation step. Either rename the tab to 'New Users' or embed the registration form directly in this tab.

The review instructions state the coder already ran npm run build and that evidence should be in the commit message or final message. No build output or success confirmation is visible in the provided context. Cannot verify that the TypeScript changes compile without errors.
